configurations.name: worktree-design
runtimeArgs: source "$HOME/.zshenv" && W="$(git worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree /{w=$2} /^branch refs\/heads\/design\//{print w; exit}')"; [ -n "$W" ] || { echo "Kein Worktree mit Branch design/… gefunden" >&2; exit 1; }; cd "$W" && exec npm run dev -- --port 3006
